review: I like the readable hazards and the ten-second stage length; Gauntlet chains saws, crumble tiles, ferries, a spring and lasers into a real route, and Spring Loaded and Laser Gate have a rhythm I would grind. But the curve is flat: First Steps kills 29 of 100 at a plain spike strip, and the mid player stood beside it for six seconds, while Saw Mill is the hardest stage at 57% in slot three. Ferry Lines and Saw Mill give all three skills the same time, so there is nothing to optimise. Spike Garden is one repeated jump, and the high-skill run there took 25 seconds.
best: Gauntlet mixes every mechanic into one fast, readable route with real risk for all skill levels.
worst: The difficulty curve is flat and out of order, with a tutorial that kills 29% and identical finish times on Saw Mill and Ferry Lines.
